alternatives.meaning: Sets whether the module is visible in the configurator's initial state.
Objects and modules write the same initial entity visibility map and are both projected through the scene visibility resolver; there is no separate initial object-activity state.

decisions.decision: Use the same visible label and accessible-name template for modules and scene objects because both control initial configurator visibility through model.initialState.entities[itemId]. Catalog key: admin.initialState.entityVisibility. The object label no longer implies a separate active-state policy.
Keep service activation separate from scene-entity visibility: services use model.initialState.services and a different selection consumer. Catalog key: admin.initialState.serviceActive.

This enables or disables a stage's participation in the flow. It is not the initial activity or selection of an entity/service and must not share that semantic copy key. The checkbox may be disabled for required stages or stages without items.

relatedAccessibleNames.meaning: Dynamic initial configurator visibility name shared by module and scene object.
Initial Viewer visibility; distinct from configurator visibility.
Dynamic initial service activity name; separate from scene-entity visibility.

visualTreatment.decision: The initial-state and stage-availability checkboxes can share the theme accent while retaining distinct state, wording, and accessibility semantics. This technical normalization does not constitute product/UX approval of the wording or a global checkbox redesign.
